dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Welcome, welcome. Our store offers the most extensive selection of precious gems in the entire Court of Fontaine. We also have the newest ornaments and craft goods for sale.

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Anything here catch your eye?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the latest ornaments on sale...

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: That's got to be the Wings of Oscillation.

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: They are modeled after the slim wings of Crystalflies. The metallurgical process used to make them is quite unique, and they are encrusted with dazzling gems...

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: They say that even the gentlest breeze will cause them to flap like real Crystalfly wings. To say that the Wings of Oscillation have taken high-class society by storm would be an understatement!

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: But though everyone loves chasing fads, I'd say that ornaments should be chosen according to their ability to bring out our unique characters.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: We often push out new products, so your patronage is always welcome!

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Welcome! We meet again.

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Are you here to see the latest ornaments this time?

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Or did you bring some special ore with you once again?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the ore we brought previously...

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: We're still at work on that front. I'm afraid the final product is some ways away...

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: I'm afraid you'll have to wait till next time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about clock production...

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Thanks to you, the mass production of the new clock model has been going smoothly, and the ores Ms. Puca has provided to us have been of high quality.

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Actually, I was planning to make a new batch of clocks designed for Melusines based on this model.

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Of course, we'll use a water-resistant clam-style structure — I'm sure this will be a market-opener!

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: The only problem we have is that Ms. Puca doesn't seem to want to use Mora as collateral for trade...

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: I've been racking my brains as to the sort of things she'll take in exchange...
